summary: Unconditional collision/physics parameter setter. Stores the global double dbl_8AFE90 into the float field at this+0xC0 (this[48]) on every call. No guards, no callees; the legacy ABI lead names it a collision speed setter and it is reached from UILargeRender (0x00496930).

local_names.this: float-typed object whose field at offset 0xC0 is updated

operations.description: Write the global double dbl_8AFE90 (0x008AFE90) into float field this[48] (offset 0xC0), the collision/physics parameter, unconditionally.
Return void; the setter performs no reads of this beyond the write and no branching.
Invoked from UILargeRender (0x00496930) as the sole caller.
